content: {"phoneNote":"The hero photo is a misty forest landscape, not the workshop or furniture, so the first screen shows nothing of what the mizar actually makes.","desktopNote":"The hero sits in a half-empty band with the headline column floating, and the hero image again shows a valley rather than wood or furniture; the nav is a lone 'Domov' link.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Replace the landscape hero with a photo of the workshop, a finished kitchen or table, and give the product list (Kuhinje, Mize…) at least small images so the trade is visible.","Tighten the desktop hero and the 1979 band: reduce the dead space below the hero and around the oversized year, and let the 'Čakalna doba' notice span or sit beside content instead of a lone box.","Drop the single-item 'Domov' nav row on desktop or fill it with section links (Kaj izdelujemo, Les, Kontakt) so the header earns its height."],"blockers":[]}
